responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines SPARC synchronization and atomic instruction support. It provides expanders and insn patterns for membar/stbar, thread fences, atomic loads and stores, compare-and-swap, swap, and ldstub across V8, V9, LEON3, and 32-/64-bit cases, using SPARC-specific UNSPEC/UNSPECV forms, memory-model handling via sparc_emit_membar_for_model, and erratum-sensitive output sequences where required.
